title: Zeus Analytics / session report sink root — base-6.1
description: Client/engine/Helios/admin STAMP fields on the Analytics/session/report ROOT — NOT Layer A (model return). Never filled by the model. Layer A remains response_output_schema.json. See ROADMAP § base-6.1 · ZC-WISH-035 · HEL-WISH-022.

user.description: Who wrote this sink row. Product Client always zeus_client. Hub/admin stamp admin. Never AI.

ip_address.description: Caller IPv4 or IPv6 textual form when known (e.g. 203.0.113.42 or 2001:db8::1). Omit when unknown or redacted. Never invent.

ts.description: Sink timestamp (ISO-8601). Client/engine clock — not model.

session_id.description: Session id for the back-and-forth when applicable.

turn.description: Optional per-turn payload; may override session defaults later.
